Willi-Food International Ltd., an Israeli kosher food distributor listed on NASDAQ and TASE, filed a Form 6-K on August 4, 2026, announcing a cash dividend of NIS 1.44 per share, approximately US$0.47, totaling NIS 20 million (US$6.5 million) based on the August 4 exchange rate. The board declared the dividend with a record date of August 18, 2026, and payment on September 3, 2026. US-dollar recipients may see a final per-share amount vary based on the Bank of Israel representative rate on the record date and shares outstanding. This is a routine capital-return event, not M&A-driven, with no takeover or strategic-change implications. Watch for currency-adjusted final payout and future distribution cadence.
